summary: The study investigates the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of ternary TixAl1 − xOy films using TiCl4, trimethylaluminum (TMA), AlCl3, and H2O as precursors. The research focuses on the passivation effect of TiCl4 on the chemisorption of TMA and AlCl3, and the impact of different precursor sequences on the deposition rate and film composition. The study also examines the growth mechanisms, surface reactions, and the influence of temperature on the deposition process.
